notes.content:

很便宜，可以先入手然后等作者更新内容和修改bug，一次购买享受一整年持续新内容更新！https://store.steampowered.com/app/2180330/2/

notes.title: 2022.11.30 Repair English patch
notes.content:
Now after using the English patch, {Composition Table} can be displayed normally.

(Players who have used English patches, please overwrite them in the game directory again!)

notes.title: Add English language patch
notes.content:
I tried my best to translate the main plot, props, status and notes of the game.
But because of the language difference between Chinese and English, I can't translate pornographic content into English accurately. 
I'm sorry, I've done my best.

notes.title: On September 9, 2022, the [pregnancy and production system] was updated
notes.content:
1. Increase the {production} system. If milk tea enters the {pregnancy} state, it will give birth to interesting things after a period of time.

2. Add {milk tea egg} related to new cuisine

The English version is still being translated, and the workload is greater than expected.

notes.title: Added shrems combat behavior and bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Added "H" in the battle of shrems

2. Change the image preprocessing method and fix the error【uncaught typeError:Cannot read property ＇width＇of the null】

(in fact, the picture looped too fast and made an error)

notes.title: Emergency Patch
notes.content: Memory room now adds [defeat - shrem mother] and [Special defeat - shrem mother]

notes.title: Updated on August 31, 2022 [new CG and new plot added]
notes.content:
1. Added the CG plot of the defeat of shrem Niang (normal clothes + changing state)

2. Added the safe house in the mountainside and the seduction plot of the aphrodisiac potion of the shrem merchant

3. Fix some minor bugs

4. Add {pregnancy system}, which is still a beta version.

5.The English version will be launched in mid September (try to achieve)

(next month will update the slym battle h, pregnancy and production system)

notes.title: Updated August 8, 2022
notes.content: 1. Fixed the bug that eating certain foods would lead to the reset of the degree of depravity

notes.title: Minor update on July 23
notes.content:
1. Optimized the novice guidance of the preface
2. Add a new item "wild Survival Guide"
Now players can check the descriptions of various abnormal states (hunger, thirst, fatigue) in the items at any time
The task guidance system is currently being tested and is believed to be ready for use soon.

notes.title: Small update (fixed the bug that the sword is equipped but can't cut trees)
notes.content: Now players can cut trees normally no matter they are equipped with +1 or +9 magic swords.

notes.title: Completely modify the synthesis system and strengthen the forging system
notes.content:
After listening to the players' opinions, I decided to get up in the middle of the night to study the new synthesis system plug-in, and stayed up until now, which was finally solved.
[the following is the specific update]
1. Overturn the previous Jiugongge synthesis and use a more convenient and intuitive formula table synthesis (you need to collect the formula first)
2. Weapon reinforcement is integrated with synthetic system in the form of [synthesis] - [weapon]
3. Weapon enhancement has three breakthroughs. Each breakthrough will give high attributes and passivity, up to +10
4. The weapon enhancement value will change according to the characteristics of the weapon.

notes.title: Some bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that CG cannot be viewed in CG room

2. Fix the bug that the body on the second floor of the first safe house cannot disappear

3. Try to fix other bugs
